title.id: Perintah Perubahan Undang-Undang Profesi Advokat Tahun 2006

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-19_2006_E-LEGAL-PROFESSION-ACT-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2006.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Legal Profession Act (Amendment) Order, of section 3 of Chapter 132.

Section 13 of the Act is amended, in sub-paragraph lv) of paragraph (a) of

(2), by deleting "person to whom a Residence Permit has been granted under regulations made under the Immigration Act" from the second and third and by substituting "permanent resident" therefor". of section 14.

Section 14 of the Act is amended, in the proviso to subsection 11), by deleting "person to whom a Residence Permit has been granted under regulations made under the Immigration Act" from the third, fourth and fifth lines and by substituting "permanent resident" therefor. Made this 21st. day of Muharam, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of February, 2006 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
